scope: Cumulative vocabulary through N4 and Minna no Nihongo I-II (chapters 1-50); exercise level retained from the supplied N4 PDFs, including foundational N5 targets
adaptations: All 50 supplied pages were visually reviewed. Each file contains questions 1-20.
Writing questions N4_5:18-20, N4_6:20 and N4_9:20 were converted into kanji-to-hiragana reading questions.
N4_1:14-16 repairs the typo shinda-no-de. N4_2:1-4 repairs the gathering verb and the mistaken writing verb to arrival (tsukimashita).
N4_2:5 had no correct company reading; N4_2:18-19 had swapped train/stop options. Both are corrected.
N4_3:1-4 repairs missing/multiple/swapped underlines to next week, Wednesday, composition and submit. N4_3:14 uses ao, not aoi, for the noun blue. N4_3:18 repairs the white answer set.
N4_4:1-3 corrects target alignment and the full akarukute reading. N4_4:14-17 repairs the negative ending; N4_4:20 removes the duplicated na.
N4_5:4-5 repairs gozenchuu and the missing narau answer. N4_5:16 reads shakai (society), not kaisha (company). N4_7:9 supplies the missing ugokikata answer.
N4_8:10-12 restores the missing to in tsuita-to-iu and the missing Tokyo/telephone underlines; repeated/incorrect choices are repaired throughout.
N4_2:11 uses shiai (match) instead of taikai; N4_9:19 uses okite (wake up) instead of okosarete. These retain the topic with vocabulary in the pinned N5-N4 source.

Harder supporting wording is simplified, including truck, backside, flourishing sports, and emphatic madamada/yappari. Repeated target words in N4_6:1 and N4_9:15 are removed from the surrounding sentence.
Source spelling, particles and punctuation are normalized. No question underlines more than one target; other kanji remain visible.

Indonesian word glosses and sentence translations are editorial additions. Distractors retain source contrasts where safe and mix dictionary-based on/kun readings; legitimate alternative readings are excluded.

scopeReview.method: Editorial review plus Janome base-form comparison with pinned OpenJLPT N5/N4 vocabulary and the supplied Minna I-II workbook.
